notes.title: Golel Demo now available.
notes.content:
If you liked Golden Fall, please try out the Demo of Golel.

Golel is a first person Dungeon Crawler that can run on lower end PCs.
It is elaborating on turn based tactical combat in a way that hasn't been done a lot before.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577730/Golel/

notes.title: Golden Fall 2 Demo, try it now.
notes.content:
Golden Fall 2 is the next chapter in Golden Fall.

In Golden Fall 2 the visuals are improved, you have attributes, you can pick skills and spells, there are even different characters to pick from, and you have achievements.

Please try out the Golden Fall 2 Demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292410/Golden_Fall_2/

[previewyoutube=B4XfdTBHM5k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Golden Fall 2 Demo now available.
notes.content:
Golden Fall 2 is now available for download on Steam!
If you liked Golden Fall, I hope you will like even more Golden Fall 2.

Golden Fall has more choices, more skills, attributes you can level up. It looks better. 

If you like Roguelikes, but with static hand tailored levels instead of random generated, you should check Golden Fall 2 Demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292410/Golden_Fall_2/
